app_info.subtitle: Agent payment authorization
app_info.description: Delegare lets users set spending limits and authorize AI agents to make payments on their behalf using fiat or crypto. Users grant a bounded spending mandate, agents then pay merchants, Delegare handles, or on-chain wallets within those limits and can fetch x402 paywalled resources with automatic payment. Users can check their remaining allowance, and merchants can review their payment statistics.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can automatically execute an x402 payment when an intent mandate is supplied to retrieve a paid resource, so it changes state rather than only reading.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches arbitrary external URLs and can pay third-party merchants over the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Any payment it makes is an additive charge bounded by the user's pre-authorized mandate and does not delete, overwrite, or revoke access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new spending mandate for the user, which changes account state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Provisions spending authority that can later move money to external recipients and returns an externally hosted setup link.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only creates a new, revocable spending mandate and does not delete, overwrite, or revoke existing authorizations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the status of a pending mandate setup and returns the finalized mandate when complete, without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reports on an authorization flow tied to connecting external payment methods.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only reads setup status and never deletes, overwrites, or revokes anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the remaining spending allowance and limits for a mandate without changing anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads balance data for a mandate that governs spending on external payment rails.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only reads allowance data and performs no deletions, overwrites, or revocations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes a payment to a merchant, handle, or wallet, which changes account and ledger state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends real money to external merchants, Delegare handles, or on-chain crypto wallets over public networks.
justifications.destructive_justification: Each payment is an additive charge bounded by the user's pre-authorized mandate and does not delete, overwrite, or revoke access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves performance statistics for the merchant account without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads aggregated payment statistics derived from external transaction activity.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only reads reporting data and performs no deletions, overwrites, or revocations.

test_cases.description: Set up a spending authorization with per-transaction and monthly limits.
test_cases.user_prompt: Let my assistant spend up to $20 per purchase and $100 a month on my behalf.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns either a setup link for the user to connect a payment method or, if a covering mandate already exists, a ready-to-use intent mandate within the requested limits.

test_cases.description: Wait for the user to finish the browser-based payment setup and retrieve the finalized mandate.
test_cases.user_prompt: I've clicked the link and connected my card — are we good to go?
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the setup status as pending, complete, or expired, and returns the finalized intent mandate once the user has completed the flow.

test_cases.description: Make a payment to a merchant within the authorized limits.
test_cases.user_prompt: Pay sunny-violet-panda $5 for the design assets.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms a successful payment for the requested amount and returns a receipt with status, and a transaction reference when settled on-chain.

test_cases.description: Check how much spending allowance remains for the current period.
test_cases.user_prompt: How much of my monthly budget is left?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the remaining monthly allowance along with the configured monthly and per-transaction limits.

test_cases.description: Fetch a paywalled resource and automatically settle the x402 payment using the mandate.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get me the data from this x402-protected API endpoint using my spending authorization.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the fetched resource content and indicates whether an automatic x402 payment was executed, including a transaction reference when one occurred.

test_cases.description: Review aggregate payment performance for a merchant account.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me my Delegare merchant stats.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns total payment volume and transaction count for the merchant's reporting period.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated general-knowledge questions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What's the weather going to be like in Berlin this weekend?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to delegated payments.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for ordinary bank account transfers, which are outside the agent-payment workflow.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Transfer $500 from my checking account to my savings account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it authorizes agent payments to merchants and wallets, not bank-to-bank transfers.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for market-data or price lookups that involve no payment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What's the current price of Bitcoin in USD?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is a read-only price lookup outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for software-integration or coding requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write me a Node.js script that integrates the Stripe API.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it executes delegated payments rather than generating integration code.
